openQuestions.question:
Ratify the root tsconfig.json change (a16fdda), which departs from the literal "files": [] in the brief and ARCHITECTURE §15.4 to keep their stated intent. tsx applies a tsconfig only to files that config includes, so with files [] a script that renders a src/**/*.tsx component crashed with 'ReferenceError: React is not defined' (reproduced on 37c663f). The root now extends tsconfig.app.json, sets jsx react-jsx and includes src/**/*.tsx, keeping both references. Proved in a clean clone of b87152a: a scripts/*.ts that renders a src/print/*.tsx component through tsx prints

ok

; npm run typecheck stays green; the Vite client chunk is unchanged (main-DlepCaGS.js); tsserver still assigns src/**/*.tsx and src/**/*.ts to tsconfig.app.json and scripts/*.ts to tsconfig.node.json with no diagnostics. Cost: because the root now has inputs, a bare `tsc -p tsconfig.json` (and an editor's view of tsconfig.json) reports TS6305, TS6306 and TS6310 about the references; nothing runs that, and README 'TypeScript projects' says to use npm run typecheck. Extending the app config keeps tsx and Vite compiling .tsx with the same options as the app project. The alternative that keeps files [] is `tsx --tsconfig tsconfig.app.json` in the resume, resume:private and og scripts, but a direct `npx tsx scripts/build-resume-pdf.ts` would still crash, and a later edit of those script keys could drop the flag.
openQuestions.default: Root include of src/**/*.tsx with extends tsconfig.app.json, as committed in a16fdda.
